# Every line is a KNOWN BUG: a site shape where injecting a comment makes the
# formatter drop or double-print one (DROPPED / DOUBLE-PRINTED), or makes a `//`
# swallow following content on its output line (SWALLOW — real content loss the
# print-once ledger is blind to, since the comment IS printed once). The gate fails
# on a line that is NOT here (a new kind of loss) and on a line here that no longer
# fires (a stale entry — delete it when you fix one). Counts are deliberately not
# pinned: they churn with every ordinary fixture PR, and a gate that fails per added
# fixture gets turned off. The PAYLOAD set is pinned, though: a shape that starts
# dropping a comment kind it used to survive is a new bug on a new ownership path.
#
# A PANIC is never listed here — that invariant is absolute, so it always fails
# the gate rather than being pinned.
#
# Format: KIND<TAB>SHAPE<TAB>PAYLOADS
